text:
```yaml
name: Trigger Flaky Tests
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/kbn-fleet-plugin/**'
      - '.github/workflows/trigger-flaky.yml'

jobs:
  trigger-flaky-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22.17.1'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm install -g @elastic/kibana-dev-tools

      - name: Bootstrap Kibana
        run: |
          npm run build -- --skip-build-dependencies
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Run unit tests for Fleet plugin
        run: |
          npm test -- --testPathPattern="packages/kbn-fleet-plugin" --testNamePattern="ButtonsFooter|CreateIntegrationUpload" --verbose
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Run integration tests for Fleet plugin
        run: |
          npm run test:jest -- --testPathPattern="packages/kbn-fleet-plugin" --testNamePattern="upload|integration" --verbose
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Check for flaky tests
        run: |
          echo "Checking for flaky test patterns..."
          # This step would typically check test results for flakiness
          # For now, we'll just verify the workflow runs successfully
          echo "Workflow completed successfully"
```
